dependencies.name: sha256sum

dependencies.name: garnet
dependencies.pinMechanism: operator-provided Garnet 0.8.1 CLI resolved from PATH; `garnet version` is captured as a rung in every packet, and an absent binary is recorded as EXIT=127 STATUS=tool-absent (unverified), never installed
surfaces: garnet-evidence check, diff-caps, build, and seal rungs

dependencies.name: cargo
dependencies.pinMechanism: operator-provided Rust toolchain resolved from PATH; fmt and test output captured with exit codes in the packet, and an absent binary is recorded as EXIT=127 STATUS=tool-absent (unverified); no network installation is performed

networkInstallPolicy: No skill helper may install or fetch an executable at invocation. Conditional tools must already exist under an operator-reviewed or lockfile-pinned environment.
